text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Elder Brother... for making you 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Elder Sister... for making you 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's just a little injury, so 
something like this is no big deal at all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...So please, don't worry. Can we... get 
back to training...?"
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you get some rest.
Just make sure you're careful, okay?
Just make sure you're careful, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice is totally fine... Little scrapes 
like this don't hurt at all...
choice_data_list: Truth is, I'm kind of a worrier
Truth is, I'm kind of a worrier

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A worrywart! So that was it... Rice is so 
sorry, I had no idea at all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Rice will take a break from 
training until she's all better... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having listened to my persuasion, Rice 
Shower spent the next while resting 
quietly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! Rice will do her best, Big 
Brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...! Rice will do her best, Big 
Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, I was about to head to 
training, but—"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Your training time for today should be 
over by now, shouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, they sent a notice saying 
maintenance was required or something, so 
our reserved time was suddenly cut 
short...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No way…… At this rate, I won't be able to 
live up to Big Brother's expectations…… 
*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No way…… At this rate, I won't be able to 
live up to Big Sister's expectations…… 
*sniff*

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I tried to encourage Rice 
Shower, but she remained downcast for 
quite a while...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you, Dear Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you, Dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll show Dear Brother that an injury like 
this is nothing to me...!
choice_data_list:
First, though, we need to let your injury 
heal.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll show Dear Sister that an injury like 
this is nothing to me...!
choice_data_list:
First, though, we need to let your injury 
heal.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... But, Rice... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. But once my injury is healed, 
Rice is gonna try super hard...!
